name: Cymatic Self-Organizer
description: Matter or media that spontaneously organizes into complex, stable, and often functional patterns under acoustic or vibrational driving. Bridges physics, biology, and information through standing wave dynamics.

seeded_from.conceptual: Strong emphasis on acoustic resonance and pattern emergence. Links E008 with biological regeneration (D5) and learning/evolution (D9) layers.

acoustic_resonance_properties.visible_macro_patterns: common at audible frequencies in fluids and granular media

yin_yang_polarity: Dynamic interplay of receptive wave storage (Yin) and active pattern formation (Yang)
